Review code, a diff, a design, a document or a ticket against criteria and return findings.

Use when you want a second opinion before something lands.

## Facts

- **Group:** [Investigate and review](/skills/#investigate-and-review)
- **Command:** `/aid-review`
- **Arguments:** `[target] -- what to review (a file/dir, PR link, ticket id, work-NNN, 'my changes', or a described target)`
- **Allowed tools:** `Read`, `Glob`, `Grep`, `Bash`, `Shell`, `Terminal`, `Write`, `Edit`, `Agent`
